long_biography.plain_text:
Hallerberg began his entrepreneurial career in 1986 with Arcturus Marine Systems, developing thrusters, stabilizers and hydraulic equipment for recreational and commercial vessels. He built the company around practical propulsion engineering and continued as its founder and president for more than three decades. His technical interests later extended to patented systems for recovering unmanned aircraft.

He subsequently founded Arcturus UAV and served as its president and chief executive. The Petaluma company developed medium-endurance aircraft including the T-20 and vertical-takeoff JUMP 20 for military and government customers. When AeroVironment acquired the business in 2021, Hallerberg represented its sellers and signed for his trust. The transaction capped a founder-led career spanning marine controls and autonomous aviation.
